entries.dependency_path: @gltf-transform/cli@4.5.1 > micromatch@4.0.8 > braces@3.0.3; eslint-config-next@16.3.8 > @next/eslint-plugin-next@16.3.8 > fast-glob@3.3.1 > micromatch@4.0.8 > braces@3.0.3
entries.exploitability: Not reachable. Runtime path: @gltf-transform/cli runs only in the server-side owner 3D pipeline and operator scripts; micromatch there only compiles constant patterns or the --pattern/--slots CLI flags, which Vistaire never passes, and GLB texture slot names are match subjects, not expanded patterns. Dev path: eslint-config-next runs only in development and CI lint.
entries.reason: No patched braces release exists (affected <= 3.0.3). Latest @gltf-transform/cli 4.5.1, micromatch 4.0.8 and @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.3.8 still resolve braces 3.0.3; npm audit only offers semver-major downgrades. Temporary acceptance, not a fix.
